title: Australian Corn Wrap Wrap
description: A creamy and light vegan wrap filled with corn and other delicious ingredients.

ingredients.name: Creamy Australian Sauce
ingredients.notes: made from vegan mayonnaise and australian bush tomato sauce

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
Spread the creamy sauce over the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add the corn kernels, chopped cucumber, and cherry tomatoes over the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
